easyPrerequisites: There is at least one creature card in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hallowed Spiritkeeper, adding {C}{C}.
When Hallowed Spiritkeeper dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Hallowed Spiritkeeper trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Hallowed Spiritkeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
